title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
The Red Sox scored 13 runs on 15 hits, including a five-run second inning, extending their winning streak to nine games.
Raymond Burgos pitched three hitless innings in his debut, helping maintain Boston's strong pitching performance.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are intensifying competition during Patriots training camp with significant 1-on-1 matchups.
Gonzalez uses strategic trash talk to prepare Brown for top cornerbacks he'll face this season.
Despite ongoing contract discussions, Gonzalez is actively participating in camp, facing demanding receivers in 2026.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman set for a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester after a trade from the Orioles to the Red Sox.
Rutschman has been on the injured list since July 20 due to left wrist inflammation but cleared for baseball activities.
The catcher, a three-time All-Star, could boost the Red Sox, who are 31-5 since June 25 and hold a wild-card spot.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' is streaming on Paramount+, continuing the saga of Aang facing new challenges.
'You, Me & Tuscany,' featuring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page, streams on Peacock with a romantic Italian setting.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 is available on Apple TV, showcasing new developments with a women's team at AFC Richmond.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet may return to the Red Sox bullpen in 2026 after shoulder and lat injuries.
Crochet missed significant time and recently began light throwing, but manager Chad Tracy suggests a bullpen role.
Crochet, previously a White Sox reliever, is open to helping the team in any role this season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found in a community food garden on Ellington Street, Dorchester, Boston.
Residents reported seeing the snake abandoned in a cage, prompting Animal Care and Control to retrieve it.
Boston Animal Care and Control is caring for Tippy and seeking information about the snake's owner.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito outperformed Drake Maye, leading Team Blue to a 22-15 win in a Patriots training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas excelled for Team Blue, securing six catches and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard score.
Key players like Will Campbell and Carlton Davis missed the scrimmage due to injuries, with updates provided by Mike Vrabel.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by more than 850 Boston.com readers.
Harwich features nearly 11 miles of coastline and over 20 beaches along Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay.
Emily Mitchell highlights Harwich's cultural attractions, community centers, and conservation areas for diverse interests.

title: DA’s office says prosecutor’s ‘hot mic’ moment in Lindsay Clancy trial was misheard
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: The Plymouth DA's office clarified that the phrase heard was 'shut it off,' not 'shut her up,' regarding autopsy photos.
Defense attorney Kevin Reddington accused prosecutors of inappropriate comments during Lindsay Clancy's trial.
Judge William Sullivan warned against inappropriate courtroom comments, threatening removal for any violations.

title: Little boy dancing to DJ on Boston Common has hundreds of thousands of new fans
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: 4-year-old Chukwuemeka Ikesinachi-Nwogwugwu danced to a DJ's music on Boston Common, with video receiving over 200,000 likes.
The boy's mom, Chidimma Ikesinachi, was surprised by the video's popularity and appreciated the positive impact it had.
DJ Miss S. Peace was hosting a popup show aimed at human connection; Kelly Werme encouraged Chukwuemeka's dance moves.
